notes.title: Version 1.10
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=X7xcrjlyZIY;full][/previewyoutube]

We've had some awesome feedback over the last few months. Most notable was players asking for a continued storyline so we finished it in this patch.

[b]Features[/b]
    Finished story/bosses
    Credits

[b]Balance[/b]
    Boss immune to bomb power
    Increase Flac Cannon range
    Boss mechanics change
    Other minor changes (more cargo drops)

[b]Design/QOL[/b]
    $ on Former upgrades
    Show correct structure names
    Fix reactor upgrade string
    Toggle ship marker
    Lowered transition time
    Make cargo more accessible (separate menu?)
    Change ark to+ show "can/can't purchase" instead of cost
    Skip track feature

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
    Sound settings not saving properly
